title: sgai skill URL map (v1)
description: Machine-readable URL contract shipped alongside the sgai agent skill (https://sgai.md/skill/SKILL.md). Maps question intents to sgai.md list/detail pages per locale. EN lives at bare paths; ZH mirrors live under /zh/.

version.description: Semver of the URL contract. Bump on any URL shape change or new domain.

site.description: Canonical site origin, without a trailing slash.

intentMatchHints.description: Question-intent key → ordered list of domain ids to consult.

localePair.description: Per-locale URL or URL template. Templates use a {placeholder} segment.

id.description: Stable domain id, matching the site's first path segment where one exists.

intent.description: One-sentence description of what questions this domain answers.

detailNote.description: How to discover valid detail slugs when validIds is absent.

validIds.description: Known-good substitutions for the detail template placeholder. Generated by scripts/skill/build-url-map.ts.
